entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis to acid
observations: ORD record ord-b11adfdffe6c4eabb87a86891d3c182e reports hydrolysis of the terminal methyl ester to the carboxylic acid using LiOH, water, methanol, THF, and acetic acid work-up.
The sulfonate and other ether substituents remain intact in the standardized reactant/product structures.

entities.name: LiOH saponification conditions
observations: LiOH with water, methanol, and THF is recorded for methyl ester hydrolysis; acetic acid is recorded for acidification/work-up. Amounts, temperature, and duration are unspecified.
